title: Escalator Brushes Are Not For Your Shoes
hook: A thing you assumed was a courtesy is actually a warning.

cast.note: Dex enjoys the brushes wrongly and enthusiastically. Mochi is the thing that nearly gets eaten.

scenes.note: Open mid-misuse. Dex is already scrubbing his shoe on the brush, delighted.

beats.action: Dex crouched at the escalator edge scrubbing a shoe against the brush, grinning; Bill watches, unsure
Bill edges closer to look at what Dex is doing, still not understanding it
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: a NOT A SHOE CLEANER card slams over the brush; Dex freezes mid-scrub
the brush turns coral and pulses; three warning marks burst above it; camera punch

scenes.note: The mechanism. Camera goes in tight on the seam so the gap is unmissable.

beats.action: hard cut to a tight side view of the step edge meeting the side panel
the gap between moving step and fixed panel lights up coral; an arrow labels it
the steps start moving and the panel visibly does not; the shear at the seam is the whole point
the panel flashes STATIONARY; the contrast holds for a beat

scenes.note: Three things get eaten in sequence. Fast, rhythmic, escalating — then Mochi.

beats.action: a loose shoelace whips into the gap and vanishes with a snap
a coat hem follows it in
a shopping bag is yanked down and gone; Bill goes horrified
Mochi's tail drifts toward the seam; she is stolen off-frame at speed and reappears above, unimpressed
beats.sync: keyword: caught — the gag on top of the danger

scenes.note: The brushes finally do their real job, on screen, to Bill's foot.

beats.action: camera pulls back to Bill standing too close to the edge
Bill checks his own shoelaces and tucks them in, quietly
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the brush touches his shoe; he flinches and lifts the foot
Bill shuffles sideways away from the edge; a teal SAFE band appears where he lands

scenes.note: Callback: Dex is still scrubbing. Nothing has been learned. Hard cut.

beats.action: wide shot: Dex is scrubbing his shoe on the brush again, blissful
Dex scrubs faster, enjoying himself more; Bill watches with growing dread
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the brush bristles bend and spring back once, patient about it
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: a little heart pops over Dex; Bill facepalms
the brush sprouts a tiny speech tail reading PLEASE MOVE
the gap gains cartoon teeth for exactly four frames; Dex finally steps back; hard cut
